structure: a tall vertical cutaway cross-section of a smart high-street estate agency building in the centre of a portrait canvas, with a giant house-shaped key on its roof.
character: young real estate intern (an East Asian man in his early 20s, short black hair, navy suit, no tie, clipboard)
scenes: he arrives with a coffee and checks a laptop showing abstract property listing cards with house icons.
he photographs a bright empty living room with a camera on a small tripod.
he shows a young couple around a flat, pointing at a large window.
he updates a big wall board of property cards with coloured pins, a phone tucked at his shoulder.
he hands a set of keys across a desk to a smiling person, a small house icon floating above; dusk through the window.
props: a giant key, a SOLD sign shape with no text, a house silhouette, a map pin, a calculator, a door, a padlock
